act_title: The Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University Act, 2013
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation

University Act, 2013.

_(2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the_

Official Gazette, appoint and different dates may be appointed for different provisions of this Act.
